title: Underwriting Footnote: the Ceiling a Corrected Trip Cost Is Held To — Travel Protection Plans
content:
A corrected declared trip cost on a Travel Protection Plans certificate is never declared above the ceiling that applies to it, and which ceiling applies is read from the underwriting desk's approved correction against the certificate and from the outlay taken.

Where an approved correction stands against the certificate and the trip cost it states is at or above the outlay taken, the ceiling that applies is the plan's ceiling for the declared trip cost.

Where an approved correction stands against the certificate and the trip cost it states is below the outlay taken, the ceiling that applies is the trip cost the approved correction states.

Where neither holds, the ceiling that applies is the quoted price of the vacation package the cover was bought alongside, one of the Vacation Package Products.

## The plan's ceiling for the declared trip cost

| Plan | Ceiling for the declared trip cost, USD |
| --- | --- |
| Trip Basics Essential | 5000.00 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 10000.00 |
| TripGuard Plus | 20000.00 |
| TripGuard Premier | 35000.00 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 50000.00 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 15000.00 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 40000.00 |

## The three cases

Both of the first two cases require an approved correction to stand against the certificate; they are told apart by how the trip cost that correction states compares with the outlay taken. At equality the first case applies — the correction stating exactly the outlay taken is at or above it — and the ceiling is the plan's own. Only where the correction states strictly less than the outlay taken does the correction's own figure become the ceiling.

Where no approved correction stands against the certificate at all, neither of the first two is reached, and the ceiling is the package's quoted price.

Hypothetically, on TripGuard Plus with an outlay taken of 18000.00 USD: an approved correction stating 18000.00 USD gives a ceiling of 20000.00 USD, the plan's own; an approved correction stating 16500.00 USD gives a ceiling of 16500.00 USD; and no approved correction at all gives a ceiling equal to the package's quoted price.
